assessment: This paper reports the identification of molecular determinants of CO2 tolerance in the human fungal pathogen Cryptococcus neoformans. The results are important for our understanding of how the fungus adapts from the ambient atmosphere to the CO2-enriched environment in the human host, and the findings are convincing and rely on biochemical, molecular, and genetic techniques. The results should be of interest to a broad community in the life sciences including microbiologists and infectious diseases investigators.
